title: 第4615章 我赌得起第4614章 你在耍我
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 一道无形的屏障横亘在虚空中，看似透明，却散发着厚重而压抑的气息。
唐天伸手触碰了一下，指尖立刻感受到一阵强烈的排斥力，像撞上了一堵看不见的墙。
“果然有东西。”
他收回手，转身飞回舰队。
“胖子，你带两艘战舰留在外围，接应我们。云皓跟我进去。”
“好嘞！”
胖子小风咧嘴一笑，虽然心里痒痒的，但执行命令从不含糊。
唐天和云皓脱离舰队，朝着禁制飞去。
临近屏障时，他从怀中取出那只黑石盒子，托在掌心。
盒子表面那些纹路在靠近禁制的瞬间，忽然亮起一层微弱的光芒。
那光芒像一把无形的钥匙，轻轻一碰，前方那道厚重如山的禁制便裂开了一道缝隙。
两人穿过缝隙，眼前豁然开朗。
荒芜星域的真面目呈现在眼前……
那是一片被暗紫色雾气笼罩的广阔空间。
雾中漂浮着无数巨大的碎块，有的像是建筑的残骸，有的像是巨兽的骨骼。
而在所有碎片中央，一道瘦削的黑影静静悬浮在那里，周身缠绕着细密的黑线。
正是那个黑影。
他比上次见面时显得更疲惫了一些，身形也淡了不少。
但那双空洞的眼睛在唐天出现的瞬间，立刻锁定了过来。
“你来了。”
“你的晶石呢？”
唐天没有多寒暄，开门见山。
黑影从怀中取出那枚暗红色的晶石，托在掌心。
晶石的光芒在暗紫色雾气中格外刺眼，像是活物一般微微跳动。
唐天也取出黑石盒子。
两件东西同时出现的瞬间，各自发出一阵低沉的嗡鸣，仿佛彼此感应到了对方的存在。
“接下来怎么弄？”
唐天问道。
黑影没有说话，只是将晶石托向唐天方向。
唐天会意，将盒子递了出去。
两件东西在半空中缓缓靠近，距离还有尺许的时候，忽然同时光芒大盛。
暗红的光芒和深黑的光芒交织在一起，化作一道耀眼的灰紫色光柱。
光柱直冲而上，射入暗紫色雾气的深处，像是一把钥匙插进了某个看不见的锁孔。
雾剧烈翻涌起来，像一锅被煮沸的水。
一个巨大的漩涡在雾中央缓缓成形，漩涡越转越快，中心处开始出现一道漆黑的裂口。
裂口边缘缭绕着密集的电光，发出低沉的轰鸣，像是什么东西正在从深处缓缓上升。
黑影的呼吸急促起来，整个人都在发抖。
唐天皱着眉，感受着那股从裂口中涌出的气息，心里已经有了判断。
那气息极为古老，比他见过的任何存在都更久远，但又带着某种快要消散的虚弱感，像一簇风中残烛。
裂口持续扩大，约莫过了十几息后，一道模糊的身影从裂口边缘浮现出来。
content_en:
An invisible barrier stretches across the void, seemingly transparent, but exuding a thick and oppressive aura.
Tang Tian reached out and touched it, and his fingertips immediately felt a strong repulsive force, as if they had hit an invisible wall.
"There is indeed something."
He retracted his hand, turned and flew back to the fleet.
"Fat man, you take two battleships and stay outside to meet us. Yun Hao comes in with me."
"Okay!"
Fatty Xiaofeng grinned. Although he felt itchy in his heart, he never hesitated to execute orders.
Tang Tian and Yun Hao broke away from the fleet and flew towards the restriction.
When he approached the barrier, he took out the black stone box from his arms and held it in his palm.
The lines on the surface of the box suddenly lit up with a faint light the moment they approached the restriction.
The light was like an invisible key. With a slight touch, the thick mountain-like restriction in front of him cracked a gap.
"Let's go!"
The two people passed through the gap, and their eyes suddenly opened up.
The true face of the desolate star field appears before our eyes...
It was a vast space shrouded in dark purple mist.
There were countless huge fragments floating in the fog, some of which looked like the remains of buildings, and some of which looked like the skeletons of giant beasts.
And in the center of all the fragments, a thin black shadow floated quietly there, with fine black lines wrapped around it.
It was that dark shadow.
He looked a little more tired than the last time we met, and his figure was also much lighter.
But those empty eyes immediately locked onto Tang Tian's appearance.
"You're here."
"Where's your crystal?"
Tang Tian didn't say much and went straight to the point.
The shadow took out the dark red crystal stone from his arms and held it in his palm.
The light of the crystal is particularly dazzling in the dark purple mist, and it beats slightly like a living thing.
Tang Tian also took out the black stone box.
The moment the two things appeared at the same time, they each made a low buzz, as if they sensed each other's presence.
"What to do next?"
Tang Tian asked.
The black shadow said nothing, but held the crystal in the direction of Tang Tian.
Tang Tian understood and handed the box out.
The two objects slowly approached each other in mid-air. When they were still a few feet away, they suddenly glowed brightly at the same time.
The dark red light and the deep black light intertwined and turned into a dazzling gray-purple light pillar.
The beam of light shot straight up and into the depths of the dark purple mist, like a key inserted into an invisible keyhole.
The fog surged violently, like a pot of boiling water.
A huge vortex slowly formed in the center of the fog. The vortex turned faster and faster, and a dark crack began to appear in the center.
The edge of the crack was surrounded by dense electric light, emitting a low roar, as if something was slowly rising from the depths.
The shadow's breathing quickened, and his whole body was trembling.
Tang Tian frowned, feeling the breath coming out of the crack, and already made a judgment in his heart.
The aura was extremely ancient, older than any existence he had ever seen, but it also carried a sense of weakness that was about to dissipate, like a bunch of candles left in the wind.
The crack continued to expand, and after about ten breaths, a vague figure emerged from the edge of the crack.
